say:0:1012501001:0.source_cn: 感知到什么了吗？布莱恩。

say:1:1012501002:0.text: You were right. I think it's the Adamant Syndicate.
say:1:1012501002:0.source_cn: 你的判断没错，混乱肮脏……正是黑金商会的气息。

say:0:1012502001:0.text: See, sure enough, the Syndicate has a base here.
say:0:1012502001:0.source_cn: 看吧，果然是黑金商会的隐蔽聚点！

say:1:1012502002:0.source_cn: 大家放慢脚步，提高警惕。

say:0:1012503001:0.text: It looks like they've been here a while. Eomir could be here.
say:0:1012503001:0.source_cn: 看样子，他们在这里逗留一段时间了。但愿能成功抓到伊米尔。

say:0:1012504001:0.text: I heard Elona's voice, Bryon. What did she say?
say:0:1012504001:0.source_cn: 我听见了艾洛娜的声音，布莱恩，它说了什么？

say:1:1012504002:0.text: The cave is not far ahead. There could be signs of Eomir.
say:1:1012504002:0.source_cn: 前方不远的洞穴，疑似出现了伊米尔的踪迹。

say:0:1012506001:0.text: Eomir seems to have rested here...
say:0:1012506001:0.source_cn: 伊米尔……好像在这里休息过？

say:1:1012506002:0.text: Let's see if there are any other clues.

say:0:1012507001:0.text: It's futile no matter how many thugs they send.
say:0:1012507001:0.source_cn: 这种程度的打手，来多少都是徒劳。

say:3:1012508001:0.text: Everyone read the letter, right? This was indeed Eomir's hiding place. He's injured and needs protection. That's why the Adamant Syndicate was here.
say:3:1012508001:0.source_cn: 信件大家都看过了吧……这里的确是伊米尔的藏身处，他在这...

say:4:1012508002:1.text: Don't leave out the key piece of information. The reward that Eomir promised them was the land here. I'm afraid that this place has already become a testing ground for the Adamant Syndicate.
say:4:1012508002:1.source_cn: 别落下关键信息，伊米尔承诺的酬劳是这片土地，恐怕……这...

say:5:1012508003:1.text: He has no right to do this!

say:6:1012508004:1.text: Selling our precious land to grove killers... How many more lies will Eomir continue to tell?
say:6:1012508004:1.source_cn: 出卖土地给黑金商会，万人敬仰的伊米尔大贤者到底还有多少谎言？

say:7:1012508005:0.text: Selling our land for protection... he must be badly hurt.
say:7:1012508005:0.source_cn: 如此酬劳换来的守卫，看样子他伤得不轻。

say:10:1012508006:1.text: Ha! I've got you now! You can't escape from me!
say:10:1012508006:1.source_cn: 嘎哈！被我抓到了！这下你们跑不了了！

say:11:1012508007:1.text: I like your bunny ears. I think I'll make a good luck charm out of them once I'm done with you.
say:11:1012508007:1.source_cn: 你们的耳朵真可爱啊，只可惜，你们很快就要成为我的下酒菜了！

say:12:1012508008:1.text: Eomir shouldn't be far. We need to give chase now.
say:12:1012508008:1.source_cn: 伊米尔应该跑不远，我们尽快追击。

say:13:1012508009:1.text: By the way, doesn't anyone want to comment on Eomir's terrible handwriting? I hadn't realized until now, but his handwriting is so horrendous.
say:13:1012508009:1.source_cn: 还有……就没人吐槽下伊米尔的字迹吗？没想到写在耀光信纸...

say:16:1012508010:1.text: At least we were able to read it.
say:16:1012508010:1.source_cn: 能看懂说明还是练过的。

say:17:1012508011:1.text: <shk>Bloody fursacks!</shk> How dare you ignore me!

say:18:1012508012:1.text: It's getting a bit too noisy. Let's quiet this fellow.

say:1:1012510002:0.text: Let's get out of here. It smells worse than skunk berries.
say:1:1012510002:0.source_cn: 快出去吧，这里的空气堪比发霉的果子……

say:0:1012511001:0.text: We have to hurry before Eomir escapes!
say:0:1012511001:0.source_cn: 在伊米尔跑远前，我们得加快脚步才行！

say:1:1012511002:0.text: To be honest, this is the first time in my life that I've seen Eironn so angry.
say:1:1012511002:0.source_cn: 实话说，我长这么大……还是第一次看到埃隆像刚才那样生气。

say:0:1012512001:0.text: No... no! This must be a dream.

say:1:1012513001:1.text: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!
say:1:1012513001:1.source_cn: 人类？你在这里做什么？不！退后！别靠近我！
say:1:1012513001:1.male: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!
say:1:1012513001:1.female: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!

choice_prompt:2:1012513001.text: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!
choice_prompt:2:1012513001.source_cn: 人类？你在这里做什么？不！退后！别靠近我！
choice_prompt:2:1012513001.male: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!
choice_prompt:2:1012513001.female: Humans? What are you doing here?! No! Get back! Don't come near me!

say:3:1012513002:1.text: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...
say:3:1012513002:1.source_cn: 一个没有恶意的人类，我一定在做梦，一定是……
say:3:1012513002:1.male: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...
say:3:1012513002:1.female: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...

choice_prompt:4:1012513002.text: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...
choice_prompt:4:1012513002.source_cn: 一个没有恶意的人类，我一定在做梦，一定是……
choice_prompt:4:1012513002.male: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...
choice_prompt:4:1012513002.female: A nice human? No, I must be dreaming...

say:5:1012513003:1.text: Help me? Yes... there's no reason for you to lie to me. I have nothing to lose.
say:5:1012513003:1.source_cn: 帮我？帮我……是啊……你不会骗我的，我早已没什么好失去的了。
say:5:1012513003:1.male: Help me? Yes... there's no reason for you to lie to me. I have nothing to lose.
say:5:1012513003:1.female: Help me? Yes... there's no reason for you to lie to me. I have nothing to lose.

say:6:1012513004:1.text: My name is Ivan, and I am the village chief of Timberhide. Before, our villagers lived a comfortable life...
say:6:1012513004:1.source_cn: 我叫伊凡，是附近林隐村的村长，原本村民们都过着安逸的生...

say:7:1012513005:1.text: However, ever since a group of humans appeared, strange rumors were abound in the village. At first, I thought it was just everyone being a little close-minded and ignorant.
say:7:1012513005:1.source_cn: 自从那群人类出现，村子里就不断有奇怪的传闻到我的耳朵，...

say:8:1012513006:1.text: But just now, a group of crazed glimmerblooms suddenly appeared. They destroyed whatever they saw in the village... Many young people were slain...
say:8:1012513006:1.source_cn: 就在刚刚，一群发疯的荧荧花出现在村里……它们看到什么就...

say:9:1012513007:1.text: My son and I also got separated in the chaos...
say:9:1012513007:1.source_cn: 我和我的儿子也在混乱中走散了……

say:10:1012513008:0.text: This all happened because of me. If I had believed those rumors in the beginning, maybe everything would be fine!
say:10:1012513008:0.source_cn: 这一切都是因为我的疏忽，如果我早点相信那些传闻的话，也...

say:11:1012513009:0.text: My village, the villagers, and my son... *Cry*... I'm the village chief, and I couldn't do anything...
say:11:1012513009:0.source_cn: 我的村子，我的村民，还有我的儿子都……呜呜……我身为一...

choice_prompt:12:1012513009.text: My village, the villagers, and my son... *Cry*... I'm the village chief, and I couldn't do anything...
choice_prompt:12:1012513009.source_cn: 我的村子，我的村民，还有我的儿子都……呜呜……我身为一个村长，居然什么都没有做……

say:13:1012513010:1.text: Really? You are unlike any human I've ever met.
say:13:1012513010:1.male: Really? You are unlike any human I've ever met.
say:13:1012513010:1.female: Really? You are unlike any human I've ever met.

say:0:1012515001:0.text: The glimmerblooms should still be in the village.
say:0:1012515001:0.source_cn: 那群荧荧花应该还在村内。

say:1:1012515002:0.text: May your road ahead be guided by the light of the Deer Spirit.
say:1:1012515002:0.source_cn: 愿你们道路的前方，总有鹿灵的微光指引。

say:0:1012516001:0.text: Yes, this must be due to the corruption.
say:0:1012516001:0.source_cn: 没错，是腐化根茎的影响。

say:1:1012516002:0.text: I didn't expect it to have spread here.
say:1:1012516002:0.source_cn: 没想到已经蔓延到这里了。

say:2:1012516003:0.text: We must find Eomir before the Lucent Tree is completely corrupted.
say:2:1012516003:0.source_cn: 我们必须尽快找到伊米尔，在流荧树完全腐化之前。

say:0:1012516101:0.text: It seems that we still haven't found the glimmerblooms.
say:0:1012516101:0.source_cn: 那个……梅林大人，可能没那么关键……我们好像，没发现荧荧花？
say:0:1012516101:0.male: It seems that we still haven't found the glimmerblooms.
say:0:1012516101:0.female: It seems that we still haven't found the glimmerblooms.

say:1:1012516102:0.text: Let's, at least, cleanse this place, then head back.
say:1:1012516102:0.source_cn: 无论如何，清理好这里还是回去告知下吧。

say:0:1012518001:0.text: There the glimmerblooms are! I was worried for a second.
say:0:1012518001:0.source_cn: 荧荧花终于出现了……讲实话我心里一直在嘀咕。

say:1:1012518002:0.text: Stop babbling. You haven't changed at all.
say:1:1012518002:0.source_cn: 碎碎念，和小时候真是一点儿也没变。

say:2:1012518003:0.text: I'm just worried there are more corrupted creatures, Lyca.
say:2:1012518003:0.source_cn: 不是的姐，我只是担心魔物没有清理干净。

say:0:1012519001:0.text: That should be the end of them. Let's return to Ivan, Magister.
say:0:1012519001:0.source_cn: 这下应该没有魔物了，我们回去找伊凡吧，梅林大人。
say:0:1012519001:0.male: That should be the end of them. Let's return to Ivan, Magister.
say:0:1012519001:0.female: That should be the end of them. Let's return to Ivan, Magister.

say:3:1012520001:1.text: Blessed Misarte, you've returned safely. Are those corrupted creatures still in Timberhide?
say:3:1012520001:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑，你们平安回来了，那些魔物还在林隐村吗？

choice_prompt:4:1012520001.text: Blessed Misarte, you've returned safely. Are those corrupted creatures still in Timberhide?
choice_prompt:4:1012520001.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑，你们平安回来了，那些魔物还在林隐村吗？

say:5:1012520002:1.text: You have my utmost gratitude, but now, I have to go find my son...
say:5:1012520002:1.source_cn: 我一定会好好感激你们的……但在这之前，我得去找到我的儿子……

say:6:1012520003:1.text: That's too dangerous. This is not something ordinary people can handle.
say:6:1012520003:1.source_cn: 那太危险了，前面不是普通人可以应付的。

say:7:1012520004:1.text: I know... Of course, I've witnessed the horrors of these creatures, but I can't stay here and hide any longer...
say:7:1012520004:1.source_cn: 我见过……我当然见过那些魔物的可怕，但我不能继续躲着了……

say:8:1012520005:1.text: My sister is right, Chief Ivan. You'll only get yourself killed.
say:8:1012520005:1.source_cn: 姐说得对，那样只会多一个人遇害而已。

say:9:1012520006:1.text: I understand your good intentions... However, I'm not an ordinary person. I am the village chief of Timberhide. I was determined to die for my village, but instead, I ran away.
say:9:1012520006:1.source_cn: 明白你们的好意……但我不是普通人……我是村长，本来我随...

say:10:1012520007:1.text: I need to save my son. How can I call myself the village chief if I can't even protect one of my own?
say:10:1012520007:1.source_cn: 我必须救回我的儿子，如果我连他都不能保护，还当什么村长呢？

say:11:1012520008:1.text: This is something I must do. I am not afraid.
say:11:1012520008:1.source_cn: 我必须面对这件事，对，我现在什么都不怕了！

say:12:1012520009:1.text: Are you sure? I think it's safer for you to stay here and wait for us...
say:12:1012520009:1.source_cn: 呃……你是认真的吗？我觉得你留在这里等我们更安全……

say:15:1012520010:1.text: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1012520010:1.source_cn: 我同意让他加入，不知你意下如何？<style=stre...
say:15:1012520010:1.male: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1012520010:1.female: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:16:1012520010.text: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:16:1012520010.source_cn: 我同意让他加入，不知你意下如何？<style=stress><player_name></style>。
choice_prompt:16:1012520010.male: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:16:1012520010.female: If he wants to join us, let him. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:17:1012520011:1.text: Magister... are you all serious about this?
say:17:1012520011:1.source_cn: 连梅林大人也……你们都是认真的吗？
say:17:1012520011:1.male: Magister... are you all serious about this?
say:17:1012520011:1.female: Magister... are you all serious about this?

say:18:1012520012:1.text: Through his fear, he has found courage. That is very noble. I do not want to trample on his courage.
say:18:1012520012:1.source_cn: 恐惧换来的勇气很高尚，我不想践踏这份勇气。

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 让他加入，分给他一把武器

say:0:1012521001:0.text: Please hold on, my son... I will be there soon...
say:0:1012521001:0.source_cn: 我的孩子，坚持住……阿爸在路上了。

say:0:1012522001:0.text: Glimmerblooms! These cursed creatures! Blasted it all!
say:0:1012522001:0.source_cn: 荧荧花！就是这些怪物！可恶……可恶！

say:1:1012522002:0.text: Stay calm! Hold on to your courage!
say:1:1012522002:0.source_cn: 冷静点，拿出你的勇气来面对它。

say:0:1012523001:0.text: Did you just say that glimmerblooms are corrupted?
say:0:1012523001:0.source_cn: 你刚才说荧荧花被操控了？

say:1:1012523002:0.text: All the creatures here seem to be corrupted.
say:1:1012523002:0.source_cn: 不光是荧荧花，确切地说，这里会出现魔物，也和腐化有关。

say:2:1012523003:0.text: That's unfortunate... What can be done...?

say:0:1012524001:0.text: What's happening up there? Is there a battle?
say:0:1012524001:0.source_cn: 前面怎么了？像是刚刚发生过战斗。

say:1:1012524002:0.text: Let's go and take a look.

say:0:1012525001:0.text: There are a lot of footprints here, including those of children.
say:0:1012525001:0.source_cn: 这里有许多凌乱的脚印，其中有小孩子的脚印。

say:1:1012525002:0.text: The footprints are recent. Your son shouldn't have gone too far, Chief Ivan.
say:1:1012525002:0.source_cn: 脚印很新。伊凡先生，你的孩子应该没走太远。

say:0:1012601001:0.text: My child... I feel relief just looking at him...
say:0:1012601001:0.source_cn: 我的孩子……哪怕早一刻也好，看到他我才能安心……

say:0:1012602001:0.text: Back off! Otherwise, you're going to get hurt!
say:0:1012602001:0.source_cn: 退后！不然我会让你尝点苦头！

say:0:1012603001:0.text: My boy! It's me! Your father!
say:0:1012603001:0.source_cn: 孩子！我的孩子！阿爸在这！

say:0:1012604001:0.text: Are you okay? Let me take a look at you.
say:0:1012604001:0.source_cn: 孩子你没事吧，让阿爸看看。

say:3:1012605001:1.source_cn: 阿爸，这些大哥哥大姐姐是谁？

say:4:1012605002:1.text: My boy, let's thank these heroes who have helped save Timberhide.
say:4:1012605002:1.source_cn: 来，孩子，我们一起感谢这些林隐村的恩人，是他们清理了魔物。

say:5:1012605003:1.text: Thank you so much! Timberhide is grateful!
say:5:1012605003:1.source_cn: 谢谢大哥哥大姐姐们！林隐村给你们添麻烦了！

say:6:1012605004:1.text:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?
say:6:1012605004:1.source_cn: 这是我们的职责，事后要感谢就谢梅林吧。\n布莱恩，刚才...
say:6:1012605004:1.male:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?
say:6:1012605004:1.female:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?

say:9:1012605005:1.text: Well, those people are very scared, so I stayed silent in order not to alarm them.
say:9:1012605005:1.source_cn: 有，那些人都很害怕，为了不惊动他们我没有声张。

say:10:1012605006:1.text: My child, are all the villagers who escaped with you here?
say:10:1012605006:1.source_cn: 孩子，和你一起逃出来的村民都在这里吗？

say:11:1012605007:1.text: Yes! Someone is injured. I came out to find some medicinal herbs!
say:11:1012605007:1.source_cn: 是的！有人受伤了，我是为了找药草才出来的！

say:14:1012605008:1.text: He is fearless. You have a brave son, Chief Ivan.
say:14:1012605008:1.source_cn: 我们看到了他刚才的无畏，你有个勇敢的儿子，伊凡。

say:15:1012605009:1.text: Yes, this child will definitely become a great village chief in the future. Better than I will ever be...
say:15:1012605009:1.source_cn: 是啊，这孩子将来一定会成为个好村长，至少比我要称职……

say:16:1012605010:1.text: Take us to other villagers. We will find a solution for medicine together.
say:16:1012605010:1.source_cn: 带我们去找其他村民吧，药草的事我们一起想办法。

say:0:1012606001:0.text: Okay, let me think... which way did I come from?
say:0:1012606001:0.source_cn: 让我想想……在哪个方向来着？

say:1:1012606002:0.text: All I remember is being deep inside the cave.
say:1:1012606002:0.source_cn: 我只记得在洞穴深处了。

say:1:1012607002:0.text: Don't be afraid. I am the child of prophecy. You are safe.
say:1:1012607002:0.source_cn: 不要怕，流荧树的孩子，我是林隐村的预言之子，从未来奔赴...

say:2:1012607003:0.text: The child of prophecy came to protect me?

say:1:1012608001:1.text: These people saved me and my father. They're heroes!
say:1:1012608001:1.source_cn: 这些人救了我和阿爸，他们是好人！

say:2:1012608002:1.text: I'm sorry I was so rude! I was scared out of my wits just now...
say:2:1012608002:1.source_cn: 真对不起，我刚才是被吓破胆了……所以才失礼的。

say:4:1012608003:0.text: But the look in your eyes just now... *laugh*... You really thought that I was the child of prophecy...
say:4:1012608003:0.source_cn: 不，你刚才的眼神，真的把我当成预言之子似的，哈哈……

say:6:1012608004:2.text: Are you finished laughing? Stop being rude.
say:6:1012608004:2.source_cn: 好啦，笑够了没有，再笑就是你失礼了。

say:7:1012608005:0.text: It's alright. I wanted to believe it was true.
say:7:1012608005:0.source_cn: 没什么，如果预言是好的，我愿意相信。

say:9:1012608006:2.text: Vina, it's great to see that you're alright. I want to check on everyone.
say:9:1012608006:2.source_cn: 维娜，能见到你无事太好了，让我见见大家。

say:10:1012608007:0.text: Many villagers are injured, so Kelvin went out to find herbs. We couldn't stop him.
say:10:1012608007:0.source_cn: 很多村民都负伤了，凯尔温也是急着要去采药草才出去的，我...

say:12:1012608008:0.text: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.
say:12:1012608008:0.source_cn: 梅林，你带着大家继续追赶伊米尔。
say:12:1012608008:0.male: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.
say:12:1012608008:0.female: Magister, you should continue going after Eomir.

say:15:1012608010:0.text: There are many corrupted creatures nearby. These villagers can't go out and find herbs like this.
say:15:1012608010:0.source_cn: 附近的魔物还有很多，光靠这些村民是没办法集齐药草的。

say:17:1012608011:0.text: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:17:1012608011:0.source_cn: 预言之子忽然离开可不太好吧，你说呢？梅林。
say:17:1012608011:0.male: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:17:1012608011:0.female: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?

choice_prompt:18:1012608011.text: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.source_cn: 预言之子忽然离开可不太好吧，你说呢？梅林。
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.male: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:18:1012608011.female: The child of prophecy can't just suddenly leave. What do you think, Magister Merlin?

say:20:1012608012:2.text: We are aware of your haste, Eironn, but this is the best way to keep us from getting separated.
say:20:1012608012:2.source_cn: 埃隆，我们知道你很着急，但以防走散，这样的确是最快的。

say:21:1012608015:0.text: Well... let's set off as soon as possible.

choice:18:0:1.text: We can help them collect herbs.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 我们一起采集完再启程
choice:18:0:1.male: We can help them collect herbs.
choice:18:0:1.female: We can help them collect herbs.

say:23:1012608013:2.text: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.
say:23:1012608013:2.source_cn: 哈，是的！我得承认你才是真正的预言之子！
say:23:1012608013:2.male: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.
say:23:1012608013:2.female: Ha! Yes! Why not? You definitely are a legend, even among Wilders, Magister Merlin.

say:24:1012608014:2.text: No wonder you two get along so well...
say:24:1012608014:2.source_cn: 呼……怪不得你们私交这么好。

choice:18:1:2.text: I am the child of prophecy!
choice:18:1:2.male: I am the child of prophecy!
choice:18:1:2.female: I am the child of prophecy!

say:0:1012609001:0.text: Timberhide owes you all a debt.
say:0:1012609001:0.source_cn: 林隐村给你们添麻烦了。

say:1:1012609002:0.text: Take care of the villagers. We'll be back.
say:1:1012609002:0.source_cn: 照顾好村民，我们很快回来。

say:0:1012610001:0.text: Bryon, where do you think the herbs are?

say:1:1012612001:1.text: Medicinal herbs! You were able to get them so quickly!
say:1:1012612001:1.source_cn: 是药草，你们竟然这么快就拿到了！

say:2:1012612002:1.text: I'll brew these herbs right away.
say:2:1012612002:1.source_cn: 我马上将药草加工一下。

say:6:1012612004:0.text: Mama, this medicine tastes so bad... but my headache is better.
say:6:1012612004:0.source_cn: 妈妈，这药好苦呀……但是没有刚才头痛了。

say:9:1012612006:1.text: Kelvin is already distributing medicine to everyone. Do you have time to come to Timberhide for a rest? Everyone in the village wants to express their gratitude.
say:9:1012612006:1.source_cn: 凯尔温已经在分药给大家了，各位大人，有时间来林隐村歇歇...

say:10:1012612007:1.text: By the way, Chief Ivan, among the various rumors you mentioned earlier, was there one about an injured Wilder who passed through here?
say:10:1012612007:1.source_cn: 伊凡，你之前提到的各种传闻，有没有一个负伤的绿裔经过这里。

say:11:1012612008:0.text: Some people claimed to have seen <style="highlight">Master Eomir</style>, but how could that be possible? They must've recognized the wrong person.
say:11:1012612008:0.source_cn: 倒是有人说，好像看到了大贤者<style=highli...

say:13:1012612009:1.text: What? Which direction was he going?

say:14:1012612010:1.text: I'm not sure, but there are no forks in the road near Timberhide. If you keep going, you'll reach <style="highlight">Slopeville</style>.
say:14:1012612010:1.source_cn: 这就无从得知了，但是，林隐村附近没什么岔口，一直往前走...

say:16:1012612011:1.text: Okay, Slopeville. We have to act quickly. We can't let Eomir escape this time!
say:16:1012612011:1.source_cn: 南坡村，我们得快点行动！这次无论如何都不能让伊米尔逃跑！

say:0:1012613001:0.text: Thank you again! Timberhide will always remember your kindness.
say:0:1012613001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们，林隐村会永远记得你们的恩情。

say:1:1012613002:0.text: My heroes, farewell! Thank you, Magister Merlin!
say:1:1012613002:0.source_cn: 大哥哥大姐姐再见！对了，谢谢梅林大人！
say:1:1012613002:0.male: My heroes, farewell! Thank you, Magister Merlin!
say:1:1012613002:0.female: My heroes, farewell! Thank you, Magister Merlin!
